front_content.text:
【干扰项排除：绝对化】

绝对化是把原文中的概率、范围或条件，改写成无条件、全称、必然。

常见触发词：all, always, never, completely, certainly, must。

判定步骤：
1) 先找原文限定词（may, often, most, in some cases）；
2) 再看选项是否把限定词抹掉。

back_content.text: 翻卡结论：原文若保留条件、概率或局部范围，选项却改成 all、always、never、must 等无条件断言，就是绝对化干扰。

analysis_content.text:
绝对化干扰通常保留原文主题，却抹掉条件。原文中的 may、often、most、under certain conditions 都是命题的一部分，不能在改写时省略。

若原文说 most participants improved after guided practice，选项写 guided practice always improves everyone，就把 most 改成 everyone、把观察结果改成必然规律。

做题时把原文和选项的范围词成对比较；一边谨慎、一边绝对，优先判为不等值。
tips: all、never、must、completely 是高风险词，不是见到就错。
关键是看原文是否给了同等强度的依据。

Many participants reported reduced stress after the workshop, and some said the effect lasted for several weeks.

正确答案：B。

原文是 many + some，表示部分人群受益、持续时间也仅限部分反馈。
B 保留了范围限定，其余选项存在绝对化。

C 保留了 especially when... 的条件限定。

练习材料（虚构情境）
阅读片段：

Researchers found a moderate association between screen time and sleep quality, but they noted that causality could not be established from the available data.

问题：哪项表述准确？

back_content.text:
正确答案：A。

原文只支持‘中等相关’，且明确‘不能确立因果’。
任何把相关写成确定因果的选项都属于绝对化推断。

analysis_content.text:
原文只支持‘中等相关’，且明确‘不能确立因果’。
任何把相关写成确定因果的选项都属于绝对化推断。

many、some 和 all 的范围不同，保留原文允许的例外。
tips: many、some 和 all 的范围不同，保留原文允许的例外。

front_content.text:
练习材料（虚构情境）
阅读片段：The review suggests that mindfulness training often improves concentration, but not every participant reports the same benefit.

题干：Which option turns the finding into an absolute claim?

哪项是绝对化？

back_content.text:
答案：B

解析：原文有 often 和 not every participant 两层限定，B 却写成 improves concentration for all participants，直接消灭了例外。
back_content.explanation: 绝对化题里，例外信息比主题信息更值钱。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：often 与 not every participant 已经说明“高频成立，但有例外”。

② 核心规律：六级绝对化题常把“总体上有效”偷换成“对所有人都有效”。如果原文亲自保留了例外，all participants 基本直接出局。

③ 验证：只要原文承认 not every participant，就不能接受 all participants。
tips: 总体趋势和全称判断是两回事。
例外被点明后，all/every 就变成高危词。

options.text: Mindfulness training often improves concentration.
Mindfulness training improves concentration for all participants.
The effect is not uniform across all participants.
The review presents a qualified positive finding.

front_content.text:
练习材料（虚构情境）
阅读片段：Some cities achieved substantial waste reduction through deposit-return schemes, although results varied sharply by enforcement quality and retailer participation.

任务：找出绝对化表述。

back_content.text:
应消除：
• Deposit-return schemes always produce the same waste-reduction outcome.
• Enforcement quality does not matter to the result.

解析：原文已说 results varied sharply by enforcement quality and retailer participation，错项把这种差异性抹掉了。
back_content.explanation: 条件差异是绝对化错项最爱抹掉的内容。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：some cities 与 varied sharply 共同提示“效果存在差异”。

② 核心规律：绝对化错项经常通过忽略条件差异，把一个依赖执行质量的政策写成 wherever, always, regardless of context。

③ 验证：只要原文说 varied sharply，就已经明确反对“同样结果”“不受条件影响”这种写法。
tips: 效果差异一旦被点明，就不能再接受“一律如此”。
条件变量被删除时，通常就是绝对化。

eliminable_items.text: Results varied sharply by enforcement quality.
Deposit-return schemes always produce the same waste-reduction outcome.
Enforcement quality does not matter to the result.

front_content.text:
练习材料（虚构情境）
阅读片段：The paper argues that public feedback dashboards can improve compliance in many settings, though the gains are modest and uneven.

题干：Which option most clearly overstates the finding?

哪项是绝对化？

back_content.text:
答案：A

解析：原文是 many settings + modest and uneven gains，A 却写成 guarantee high compliance everywhere，直接把范围和程度同时推满。
back_content.explanation: 双重绝对化通常更容易识别，因为它会同时过强两层。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：many settings、modest、uneven 三个词都在限制结论。

② 核心规律：当原文同时给出范围限定和程度限定时，错项最爱“双重绝对化”——一边把范围推到 everywhere，一边把程度推到 high/guaranteed。

③ 验证：原文连 gain 都说 modest，选项若写 high compliance guarantees，几乎可以秒排。
tips: 范围和程度都可能被绝对化。
modest/uneven 一旦出现，就要防 guarantee/high/everywhere。

options.text: Feedback dashboards guarantee high compliance everywhere.
The paper suggests dashboards may help in many contexts, but not evenly.
Any gains appear limited rather than dramatic.
The finding is positive but qualified.

source_ref.note: Standalone authored or adapted practice. Historical attributions were not authenticated; this exercise is not represented as an official exam question.

front_content.text:
练习材料（虚构情境）
阅读片段：Most respondents preferred hybrid schedules, but a noticeable minority still favored fully remote work.

任务：找出绝对化表达。

back_content.text:
应消除：
• Everyone preferred hybrid schedules.
• Nobody favored fully remote work.

解析：原文已经明说 a noticeable minority favored fully remote work，这两条都与证据冲突。
back_content.explanation: 调查结果里，量词就是命题边界。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：most 与 minority 是经典“主趋势+例外”结构。

② 核心规律：绝对化题最容易在调查类句子里出现，因为读者常把 most 误读成 almost all，再进一步误读成 everyone。

③ 验证：只要 minority 明确存在，nobody 之类词就不成立。
tips: 调查题先看量词。
most 绝不自动等于 everyone。

front.text:
练习材料（虚构情境）
阅读片段：Most respondents preferred hybrid schedules, but a noticeable minority still favored fully remote work.

任务：找出绝对化表达。
front.task_prompt:
阅读片段：Most respondents preferred hybrid schedules, but a noticeable minority still favored fully remote work.

任务：找出绝对化表达。

analysis.text:
① 识别信号：most 与 minority 是经典“主趋势+例外”结构。

② 核心规律：绝对化题最容易在调查类句子里出现，因为读者常把 most 误读成 almost all，再进一步误读成 everyone。

③ 验证：只要 minority 明确存在，nobody 之类词就不成立。
tips: 调查题先看量词。
most 绝不自动等于 everyone。

front_content.text:
练习材料（虚构情境）
阅读片段：The article indicates that younger workers are often more willing to switch employers, but the tendency is weaker in sectors with strong apprenticeship traditions.

题干：Which option is the clearest absolute distortion?

哪项是绝对化？

back_content.text:
答案：D

解析：原文用 often 表示高频趋势，又用 weaker in... 说明存在场景削弱。D 把它写成 always willing to leave any employer, 显然过度。
back_content.explanation: 带条件的趋势结论，最怕被改成无条件定律。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：often 与 weaker in some sectors 已给出双重保留。

② 核心规律：带有场景差异的趋势，最容易被错项写成 everywhere / always / any employer。

③ 验证：原文甚至指出 apprenticeship traditions 会削弱倾向，因此 any employer, always willing 这种写法直接越界。
tips: 趋势词+场景差异，一定防绝对化。
any/every/always 常把局部趋势写成普遍法则。

options.text: Younger workers are often more willing to change employers.
The tendency is weaker in sectors with strong apprenticeship traditions.
The article presents a trend with an important qualification.
Younger workers are always willing to leave any employer, regardless of sector.
